content: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call emergency services (911). For other cases, contact a poison control center without delay. Residents in the United States can reach the poison control center by calling 1-800-222-1222. To prevent or alleviate constipation, consider making lifestyle changes such as engaging in regular physical activity, ensuring adequate hydration by drinking sufficient water, and consuming a balanced diet rich in fiber. Foods high in fiber include bran, fresh fruits, and vegetables. If you miss a dose of your medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so.
